guard: a delegation refusal with no row to copy from names the flags and their wide default in prose, and prints no pasteable grant line at all
why: A spawner's own ACL is the CEILING every agent beneath it is attenuated against, so the repair for
a broken delegation chain decides that ceiling. Both arms of this branch are arms with NO ROW to
copy that ceiling from: the missing-spawner row does not exist yet, and the revoke DELETED the
revoked one, so `cotal actor list` cannot help on either.
THE PROPERTY. An arm with no row to copy from prints NO pasteable grant line. Not a better line: no
line. Every line such an arm could print is wrong in one of exactly two ways, and this site shipped
both in turn and had both caught by a reviewer who pasted them:
- a line carrying channel values invents them (S2), and the shortest route to a command that does
not throw is to delete the flags,
- a line short of all three flags widens on paste (S1, S4), because `runActor` fills every omitted
The refusal therefore names the verb, the flags and the default in prose, and leaves nothing an
operator can select and run. S1/S2/S4 are the three shapes that were rejected, replayed.
S1 is the text shipped in v0.21.0. S4 is the first fix for it, which added correct prose and left
the runnable line in place: it is the one that proves the prose cell alone does not close this, and
the two cells are not redundant. S2 is the second fix, with placeholder values.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports the ledger by relative source path (../src/index.js), so the
mutated file is the file that runs and there is no build in the command.
